prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) weeping willow tree; 2) twisted swamp tree with hanging moss; 3) clump of tall reeds; 4) lily pads with a white flower; 5) wooden stilt posts with rope; 6) old bronze bell on a wooden frame; 7) leaning gravestone with moss; 8) will-o-wisp lantern post (lantern unlit, pale glass); 9) rotten stump in water; 10) wooden boardwalk steps; 11) mangrove root cluster; 12) fishing trap basket; 13) small rowboat stuck in mud; 14) crooked signpost (blank); 15) cluster of glowing pale mushrooms.
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 15 distinct isolated props for a top-down pixel-art swamp JRPG. Layout exactly 3 COLUMNS by 5 ROWS, reading left to right then top to bottom. Large clear transparent gutters between every item, all sprites fully visible with generous exterior margins, nothing touching. Row 1: (1) weeping willow tree; (2) twisted swamp tree with hanging moss; (3) clump of tall reeds. Row 2: (4) lily pads with a WHITE flower; (5) wooden stilt posts with rope; (6) old bronze bell hanging on a wooden frame. Row 3: (7) leaning gravestone with moss; (8) will-o-wisp lantern post with UNLIT pale glass; (9) rotten stump in water, with only small attached water detail. Row 4: (10) wooden boardwalk steps; (11) mangrove root cluster; (12) fishing trap basket. Row 5: (13) small rowboat stuck in mud, minimal mud attached to boat; (14) crooked BLANK signpost; (15) cluster of pale mushrooms, render as pale colored caps without any emitted light or glowing halo. Props depicted at classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle, visible tops and front faces, standing upright with bases toward bottom. Trees approximately 60-70 art pixels high, small props 16-24 art pixels high; allocate sufficient canvas size and gutters for distinct elements. Premium hand-crafted modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG sprites. Crisp, uniform large square pixels throughout, aligned to ONE consistent pixel grid, nearest-neighbor edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth outlines, no soft brush, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering or checkerboards. Distinct pixel clusters of 3-10 pixels, strong readable silhouettes, 4-6 shades per material, rich earthy worn colors, hue-shifted shade ramps: saturated purple-red shadows, warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast evening light, clean base colors. Strictly NO cast shadows, NO drop shadows, NO ground plane under the props, NO nighttime darkness, NO emitted light, NO glow, NO pools of light, NO vignette.
